scope: Actual pixel comparison of prior stage, growth-v1, growth-v2 and final7 captures, including a ground diagnostic. Performance was not judged from still images.
decision: Freeze growth-v2 as a limited local structural improvement; premium garden quality remains unfinished
observed_improvements: The long green strip no longer divides the full garden into two uniform bands.
Rear shrub retreats left/back from the hero lower-left canopy, improving silhouette separation.
Final tall foreground moss shoulder is lower and narrower than B before the local correction.
All6 ordinary compositions retain the hero and night lighting without an obvious new major visual regression.
remaining: 主幹の大きなS字面は滑らかな彫刻状で、古木の侵食・捻れ・生きた流れの説得力が未達。今回の固定対象。
背景の裸枝と細い葉房は依然として硬く、小枝の繰り返しが見える。個体別の軸と中間分岐だけでは自然な樹冠の量感に届かない。
苔は同一地面へ統合したが、画面では滑らかな緑の面に見え、石際の薄い層・起伏・生育密度の説得力が弱い。
砂利は連続する細粒だが一様。建築の大きな矩形、単純な面/影も残る。
390pxと縦長構図は主役が切れないものの上下の余白が大きい。通常6構図の主役・カメラは今回変更していない。
first_candidate: Hold: green strip removed, but mobile gravel became too empty and exposed branches remained hard.
second_candidate: Limited adoption after one local tall-foreground shoulder/root contact correction. Not a third full-scene design.
